name: Trending Value
summary: Cheapest decile on a six-factor value composite, then the strongest 6-month momentum among them.

source.title: What Works on Wall Street
source.author: James P. O'Shaughnessy
source.locator: Value Composite Two; Trending Value combination
adaptations: Financials are excluded in this version. O'Shaughnessy screens an all-stocks universe and the catalog calls for dropping EV/EBITDA from the composite for banks and renormalising over the remaining five factors; the DSL cannot express a per-sector composite yet, so shipping the all-stocks universe would silently rank banks on a metric that is NULL for them. Tracked for M5 — see docs/04-SCREENER-CATALOG.md §7.
If the eligible universe falls below 300 names the selection widens from the cheapest decile to the cheapest quintile, and the UI states it.
